caption: Each column is one basis state, |00⟩ to |11⟩: the pixel values 3, 4, 0, 5 are divided by the norm 7.071 to give the amplitudes, and squaring them gives the read-out probabilities. Reading |11⟩ gives 0.500, while the zero pixel at |10⟩ can never be read.

spec.title: 2×2 patch → 2 qubits (worked example)
spec.aria: An array with four columns for the basis states 00, 01, 10, 11 showing the pixel values 3, 4, 0, 5, the normalised amplitudes 0.424, 0.566, 0, 0.707, and the probabilities 0.180, 0.320, 0, 0.500.
